title: Managed and Native Crash Diagnosis with Exit Information Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies managed and native crash diagnosis with exit information?
options: Tie crash evidence to the exact release mapping/symbols and reconstruct a reproducible causal path.
questions.answer: Tie crash evidence to the exact release mapping/symbols and reconstruct a reproducible causal path.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A source revision uniquely determines native addresses even when toolchain and linking inputs change.
questions.explanation: Using a mapping or native-symbol archive from a “similar” build can produce plausible but incorrect function names and send diagnosis toward the wrong code.

questions.prompt: Which identity links native frames to symbols reliably?
questions.answer: The exact binary/build ID and its matching symbol artifact, indexed with the release.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
